instruction: Please justify all the text in the document.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires justifying all paragraphs. Evaluator checks that >= 95% of paragraphs have justify alignment.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement to justify all text in the document
Metric uses python-docx to properly check paragraph alignment against WD_PARAGRAPH_ALIGNMENT.JUSTIFY
Getter (get_vm_file) correctly fetches the saved docx file from VM after postconfig saves it
Complete coverage: checks all paragraphs with text content (filters empty paragraphs appropriately)
Logical correctness: 95% threshold is reasonable and allows for edge cases like headers that may not be justified
Proper data flow: VM file save → file fetch → docx parsing → alignment verification
Good error handling: returns 0.0 on exceptions and empty documents
Postconfig correctly saves the document before verification (Ctrl+S)
